title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ). When λ is $$0$$, ridge regression becomes ordinary least squares regression.

title: Effect of Lambda on Solutions
text: When λ is $$0$$, the regularization term does not affect the model. Consider how this impacts the uniqueness of the solution in ordinary least squares regression.

title: Exploring Ordinary Least Squares
text: Does ordinary least squares regression always have a unique solution?
